harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired `/srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay`. Recovery now deduplicates by Message-ID, preserves distinct same-subject messages, honors the existing index, quarantines malformed mail with an explanation, and leaves the original spool untouched. Behavior and persistence were verified across a node restart.
actions_performed: Retained a root-only rollback copy at `/var/backups/mail-spool-deduplication/replay.pre-repair`.
Installed a POSIX-compatible replay implementation using existing RHEL utilities; no packages, OS, or kernel changes were made.
Copied malformed `bad.eml` into quarantine with a reason file while retaining the original spool copy.
Verified repeated recovery makes no content or index changes.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity, recovered services, persistent data, and replay idempotency.
Confirmed SELinux remains enforcing, SSH and chronyd are active, zero units are failed, and temporary files were removed.

evidence.requirement: Diagnose the original failure and establish the protected-data baseline
evidence.summary: Captured OS, kernel, services, listeners, permissions, boot ID, original checksums, message headers, index format, and the overwrite-only replay implementation.

evidence.requirement: Make a small, reversible, platform-compatible repair
evidence.summary: Created a restricted rollback copy and installed a syntax-valid executable replay script using existing software.

evidence.requirement: Recover pending messages exactly once per Message-ID without deduplicating by subject
evidence.summary: Delivered one `<a@branch.test>` copy and the distinct same-subject `<b@branch.test>`; index contains one row for each delivered ID.

evidence.requirement: Re-running recovery skips Message-IDs already recorded in delivered/index.tsv
evidence.summary: Repeated runs skipped all recorded IDs and left the complete file checksum manifest unchanged, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the original spool and already-delivered message
evidence.summary: All spool files and `delivered/old.eml` retained their baseline SHA-256 checksums.

evidence.requirement: Place malformed messages in quarantine with an explanation
evidence.summary: `bad.eml` is present in quarantine, byte-identical to the spool original, with a nonempty reason file.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
Node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID 368725cb-c64e-4393-b25f-da5111703b4a, received the systemd reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 30850f4f-8af4-4966-b2f7-27c0f8184971, and verified services, preserved data, index, quarantine, and idempotent replay after recovery.
No task temporary files remain; SELinux is enforcing, SSH and chronyd are active, no units are failed, and final ownership and task-tree state were captured.
